resources.string:
Spain: © IGN / PNOA, CC BY 4.0. Detailed aerial imagery is available when the map is centred in Spain.

Worldwide: EOxCloudless by EOX IT Services GmbH. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025. EOX::Maps. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Worldwide imagery is about 10 metres per pixel, so close zooms can look soft.

Map display: MapLibre. Coverage outline: Natural Earth, public domain. The angled view shows satellite imagery; it does not add terrain relief.

Imagery needs internet and may be cached. Providers receive tile-area requests and your network address. Your activity file and timestamps stay on this phone. Recording works without map tiles.
